decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1) Planning Permission for the erection of a two storey side extension and conversion to 2x one bedroom flats be refused for the following reasons:

i) The proposal would result in the unacceptable loss of a small house suitable for single-family occupation for which there is an identified need in the Borough, contrary to policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of the Council's Unitary Development Plan.

ii) The conversion of an existing single family house to form two flats would be harmful to neighbours' living conditions, through increased noise and disturbance. Contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and H.3.4 (Conversion of Houses to Flats) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

iii) The two storey side extension by incorporating a flat roof and a parapet wall and failing to provide a set back from the first floor front wall or a set in from the neighbouring boundary would create a 'terracing effect' harmful to the appearance of this house and the street scene as a whole contrary to ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

iv) The proposed first floor side extension would be harmful to living condition of residents at No.16 Francis Road, through creating an unacceptable and overbearing sense of enclosure and a loss of outlook, contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of two storey side extension and conversion to 2 x one bed flats.
